arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلذَّٰرِيَٰتِ ذَرْوًۭا
transliteration: Waz-zaariyaati zarwaa

translations.en.sahih: By those [winds] scattering [dust] dispersing
translations.en.pickthall: By those that winnow with a winnowing
translations.en.yusufali: By the (Winds) that scatter broadcast;
translations.id.indonesian: Demi (angin) yang menerbangkan debu dengan kuat.

arabic: فَٱلْحَٰمِلَٰتِ وِقْرًۭا
transliteration: Falhaamilaati wiqraa

translations.en.sahih: And those [clouds] carrying a load [of water]
translations.en.pickthall: And those that bear the burden (of the rain)
translations.en.yusufali: And those that lift and bear away heavy weights;
translations.id.indonesian: dan awan yang mengandung hujan,

arabic: فَٱلْجَٰرِيَٰتِ يُسْرًۭا
transliteration: Faljaariyaati yusraa

translations.en.sahih: And those [ships] sailing with ease
translations.en.pickthall: And those that glide with ease (upon the sea)
translations.en.yusufali: And those that flow with ease and gentleness;
translations.id.indonesian: dan kapal-kapal yang berlayar dengan mudah.

arabic: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَٰتِ أَمْرًا
transliteration: Falmuqassimaati amraa

translations.en.sahih: And those [angels] apportioning [each] matter,
translations.en.pickthall: And those who distribute (blessings) by command,
translations.en.yusufali: And those that distribute and apportion by Command;-
translations.id.indonesian: dan (malaikat-malaikat) yang membagi-bagi urusan,

arabic: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌۭ
transliteration: Innamaa too'adoona la-saadiq

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, what you are promised is true.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! that wherewith ye are threatened is indeed true,
translations.en.yusufali: Verily that which ye are promised is true;
translations.id.indonesian: sesungguhnya apa yang dijanjikan kepadamu pasti benar.

arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ
transliteration: Wa innad deena la waaqi'

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! the judgment will indeed befall.
translations.en.yusufali: And verily Judgment and Justice must indeed come to pass.
translations.id.indonesian: dan sesungguhnya (hari) pembalasan pasti terjadi.

arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
transliteration: Wassamaaa'i zaatil hubuk

translations.en.sahih: By the heaven containing pathways,
translations.en.pickthall: By the heaven full of paths,
translations.en.yusufali: By the Sky with (its) numerous Paths,
translations.id.indonesian: Demi langit yang mempunyai jalan-jalan,

arabic: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍۢ مُّخْتَلِفٍۢ
transliteration: Innakum lafee qawlim mukhtalif

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, you are in differing speech.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! ye, forsooth, are of various opinion (concerning the truth).
translations.en.yusufali: Truly ye are in a doctrine discordant,
translations.id.indonesian: sesungguhnya kamu benar-benar dalam keadaan berbeda pendapat,

arabic: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
transliteration: Yu'faku 'anhu man ufik

translations.en.sahih: Deluded away from the Qur'an is he who is deluded.
translations.en.pickthall: He is made to turn away from it who is (himself) averse.
translations.en.yusufali: Through which are deluded (away from the Truth) such as would be deluded.
translations.id.indonesian: dipalingkan daripadanya (Rasul dan Al-Quran) orang yang dipalingkan.

arabic: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
transliteration: Qutilal kharraasoon

translations.en.sahih: Destroyed are the falsifiers
translations.en.pickthall: Accursed be the conjecturers
translations.en.yusufali: Woe to the falsehood-mongers,-
translations.id.indonesian: Terkutuklah orang-orang yang banyak berdusta,

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍۢ سَاهُونَ
transliteration: Allazeena hum fee ghamratin saahoon

translations.en.sahih: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.
translations.en.pickthall: Who are careless in an abyss!
translations.en.yusufali: Those who (flounder) heedless in a flood of confusion:
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) orang-orang yang terbenam dalam kebodohan yang lalai,

arabic: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
transliteration: Yas'aloona ayyaana yawmud Deen

translations.en.sahih: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"
translations.en.pickthall: They ask: When is the Day of Judgment?
translations.en.yusufali: They ask, "When will be the Day of Judgment and Justice?"
translations.id.indonesian: mereka bertanya: "Bilakah hari pembalasan itu?"

arabic: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
transliteration: Yawma hum 'alan naari yuftanoon

translations.en.sahih: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire
translations.en.pickthall: (It is) the day when they will be tormented at the Fire,
translations.en.yusufali: (It will be) a Day when they will be tried (and tested) over the Fire!
translations.id.indonesian: (Hari pembalasan itu) ialah pada hari ketika mereka diazab di atas api neraka.

arabic: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
transliteration: Zooqoo fitnatakum haa zal lazee kuntum bihee tas ta'jiloon

translations.en.sahih: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."
translations.en.pickthall: (And it will be said unto them): Taste your torment (which ye inflicted). This is what ye sought to hasten.
translations.en.yusufali: "Taste ye your trial! This is what ye used to ask to be hastened!"
translations.id.indonesian: (Dikatakan kepada mereka): "Rasakanlah azabmu itu. Inilah azab yang dulu kamu minta untuk disegerakan".

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ
transliteration: Innal muttaqeena fee jannaatinw wa 'uyoon

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! those who keep from evil will dwell amid gardens and watersprings,
translations.en.yusufali: As to the Righteous, they will be in the midst of Gardens and Springs,
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang bertakwa itu berada dalam taman-taman (surga) dan mata air-mata air,

arabic: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
transliteration: Aakhizeena maaa aataahum Rabbuhum; innahum kaanoo qabla zaalika muhsineen

translations.en.sahih: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.
translations.en.pickthall: Taking that which their Lord giveth them; for lo! aforetime they were doers of good;
translations.en.yusufali: Taking joy in the things which their Lord gives them, because, before then, they lived a good life.
translations.id.indonesian: sambil menerima segala pemberian Rabb mereka. Sesungguhnya mereka sebelum itu di dunia adalah orang-orang yang berbuat kebaikan.

arabic: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًۭا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
transliteration: kaanoo qaleelam minal laili maa yahja'oon

translations.en.sahih: They used to sleep but little of the night,
translations.en.pickthall: They used to sleep but little of the night,
translations.en.yusufali: They were in the habit of sleeping but little by night,
translations.id.indonesian: Di dunia mereka sedikit sekali tidur diwaktu malam.

arabic: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
transliteration: Wa bilashaari hum yastaghfiroon

translations.en.sahih: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,
translations.en.pickthall: And ere the dawning of each day would seek forgiveness,
translations.en.yusufali: And in the hour of early dawn, they (were found) praying for Forgiveness;
translations.id.indonesian: Dan selalu memohonkan ampunan diwaktu pagi sebelum fajar.

arabic: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّۭ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
transliteration: Wa feee amwaalihim haqqul lissaaa'ili walmahroom

translations.en.sahih: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.
translations.en.pickthall: And in their wealth the beggar and the outcast had due share.
translations.en.yusufali: And in their wealth and possessions (was remembered) the right of the (needy,) him who asked, and him who (for some reason) was prevented (from asking).
translations.id.indonesian: Dan pada harta-harta mereka ada hak untuk orang miskin yang meminta dan orang miskin yang tidak mendapat bagian.

arabic: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَٰتٌۭ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
transliteration: Wa fil ardi aayaatul lilmooqineen

translations.en.sahih: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]
translations.en.pickthall: And in the earth are portents for those whose faith is sure.
translations.en.yusufali: On the earth are signs for those of assured Faith,
translations.id.indonesian: Dan di bumi itu terdapat tanda-tanda (kekuasaan Allah) bagi orang-orang yang yakin.

arabic: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
transliteration: Wa feee anfusikum; afalaa tubsiroon

translations.en.sahih: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?
translations.en.pickthall: And (also) in yourselves. Can ye then not see?
translations.en.yusufali: As also in your own selves: Will ye not then see?
translations.id.indonesian: dan (juga) pada dirimu sendiri. Maka apakah kamu tidak memperhatikan?

arabic: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
transliteration: Wa fissamaaa'i rizqukum wa maa too'adoon

translations.en.sahih: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.
translations.en.pickthall: And in the heaven is your providence and that which ye are promised;
translations.en.yusufali: And in heaven is your Sustenance, as (also) that which ye are promised.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan di langit terdapat (sebab-sebab) rezekimu dan terdapat (pula) apa yang dijanjikan kepadamu.

arabic: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّۭ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
transliteration: Fawa Rabbis samaaa'i wal ardi innahoo lahaqqum misla maa annakum tantiqoon

translations.en.sahih: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.
translations.en.pickthall: And by the Lord of the heavens and the earth, it is the truth, even as (it is true) that ye speak.
translations.en.yusufali: Then, by the Lord of heaven and earth, this is the very Truth, as much as the fact that ye can speak intelligently to each other.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka demi Tuhan langit dan bumi, sesungguhnya yang dijanjikan itu adalah benar-benar (akan terjadi) seperti perkataan yang kamu ucapkan.

arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
transliteration: Hal ataaka hadeesu daifi Ibraaheemal mukrameen

translations.en.sahih: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham? -
translations.en.pickthall: Hath the story of Abraham's honoured guests reached thee (O Muhammad)?
translations.en.yusufali: Has the story reached thee, of the honoured guests of Abraham?
translations.id.indonesian: Sudahkah sampai kepadamu (Muhammad) cerita tentang tamu Ibrahim (yaitu malaikat-malaikat) yang dimuliakan?

arabic: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا ۖ قَالَ سَلَٰمٌۭ قَوْمٌۭ مُّنكَرُونَ
transliteration: Iz dakhaloo 'alaihi faqaaloo salaaman qaala salaamun qawmum munkaroon

translations.en.sahih: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace, [you are] a people unknown.
translations.en.pickthall: When they came in unto him and said: Peace! he answered, Peace! (and thought): Folk unknown (to me).
translations.en.yusufali: Behold, they entered his presence, and said: "Peace!" He said, "Peace!" (and thought, "These seem) unusual people."
translations.id.indonesian: (Ingatlah) ketika mereka masuk ke tempatnya lalu mengucapkan: "Salaamun". Ibrahim menjawab: "Salaamun (kamu) adalah orang-orang yang tidak dikenal".

arabic: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍۢ سَمِينٍۢ
transliteration: Faraagha ilaaa ahlihee fajaaa'a bi'ijlin sameen

translations.en.sahih: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf
translations.en.pickthall: Then he went apart unto his housefolk so that they brought a fatted calf;
translations.en.yusufali: Then he turned quickly to his household, brought out a fatted calf,
translations.id.indonesian: Maka dia pergi dengan diam-diam menemui keluarganya, kemudian dibawanya daging anak sapi gemuk.

arabic: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
transliteration: Faqarrabahooo ilaihim qaala alaa taakuloon

translations.en.sahih: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"
translations.en.pickthall: And he set it before them, saying: Will ye not eat?
translations.en.yusufali: And placed it before them.. he said, "Will ye not eat?"
translations.id.indonesian: Lalu dihidangkannya kepada mereka. Ibrahim lalu berkata: "Silahkan anda makan".

arabic: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةًۭ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍۢ
transliteration: Fa awjasa minhm khee fatan qaaloo laa takhaf wa bashsharoohu bighulaamin 'aleem

translations.en.sahih: And he felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.
translations.en.pickthall: Then he conceived a fear of them. They said: Fear not! and gave him tidings of (the birth of) a wise son.
translations.en.yusufali: (When they did not eat), He conceived a fear of them. They said, "Fear not," and they gave him glad tidings of a son endowed with knowledge.
translations.id.indonesian: (Tetapi mereka tidak mau makan), karena itu Ibrahim merasa takut terhadap mereka. Mereka berkata: "Janganlah kamu takut", dan mereka memberi kabar gembira kepadanya dengan (kelahiran) seorang anak yang alim (Ishak).

arabic: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍۢ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌۭ
transliteration: Fa aqbalatim ra-atuhoo fee sarratin fasakkat wajhahaa wa qaalat 'ajoozun 'aqeem

translations.en.sahih: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"
translations.en.pickthall: Then his wife came forward, making moan, and smote her face, and cried: A barren old woman!
translations.en.yusufali: But his wife came forward (laughing) aloud: she smote her forehead and said: "A barren old woman!"
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian isterinya datang memekik lalu menepuk mukanya sendiri seraya berkata: "(Aku adalah) seorang perempuan tua yang mandul".

arabic: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
transliteration: Qaaloo kazaaliki qaala Rabbuki innahoo huwal hakeemul 'aleem

translations.en.sahih: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."
translations.en.pickthall: They said: Even so saith thy Lord. Lo! He is the Wise, the Knower.
translations.en.yusufali: They said, "Even so has thy Lord spoken: and He is full of Wisdom and Knowledge."
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka berkata: "Demikianlah Tuhanmu memfirmankan" Sesungguhnya Dialah yang Maha Bijaksana lagi Maha Mengetahui.

arabic: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
transliteration: Qaala famaa khatbukum ayyuhal mursaloon

translations.en.sahih: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"
translations.en.pickthall: (Abraham) said: And (afterward) what is your errand, O ye sent (from Allah)?
translations.en.yusufali: (Abraham) said: "And what, O ye Messengers, is your errand (now)?"
translations.id.indonesian: Ibrahim bertanya: "Apakah urusanmu hai para utusan?"

arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ مُّجْرِمِينَ
transliteration: Qaalooo innaaa ursilnaaa ilaa qawmim mujrimeen

translations.en.sahih: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals
translations.en.pickthall: They said: Lo! we are sent unto a guilty folk,
translations.en.yusufali: They said, "We have been sent to a people (deep) in sin;-
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka menjawab: "Sesungguhnya kami diutus kepada kaum yang berdosa (kaum Luth),

arabic: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن طِينٍۢ
transliteration: Linursila 'alaihim hijaa ratam min teen

translations.en.sahih: To send down upon them stones of clay,
translations.en.pickthall: That we may send upon them stones of clay,
translations.en.yusufali: "To bring on, on them, (a shower of) stones of clay (brimstone),
translations.id.indonesian: agar kami timpakan kepada mereka batu-batu dari tanah,

arabic: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
transliteration: Musawwamatan 'inda rabbika lilmusrifeen

translations.en.sahih: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."
translations.en.pickthall: Marked by thy Lord for (the destruction of) the wanton.
translations.en.yusufali: "Marked as from thy Lord for those who trespass beyond bounds."
translations.id.indonesian: yang ditandai di sisi Tuhanmu untuk membinasakan orang-orang yang melampaui batas".

arabic: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
transliteration: Fa akhrajnaa man kaana feehaa minal mu'mineen

translations.en.sahih: So We brought out whoever was in the cities of the believers.
translations.en.pickthall: Then we brought forth such believers as were there.
translations.en.yusufali: Then We evacuated those of the Believers who were there,
translations.id.indonesian: Lalu Kami keluarkan orang-orang yang beriman yang berada di negeri kaum Luth itu.

arabic: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
transliteration: Famaa wajadnaa feehaa ghaira baitim minal muslimeen

translations.en.sahih: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.
translations.en.pickthall: But We found there but one house of those surrendered (to Allah).
translations.en.yusufali: But We found not there any just (Muslim) persons except in one house:
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami tidak mendapati negeri itu, kecuali sebuah rumah dari orang yang berserah diri.

arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
transliteration: Wa taraknaa feehaaa aayatal lillazeena yakhaafoonal 'azaabal aleem

translations.en.sahih: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
translations.en.pickthall: And We left behind therein a portent for those who fear a painful doom.
translations.en.yusufali: And We left there a Sign for such as fear the Grievous Penalty.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami tinggalkan pada negeri itu suatu tanda bagi orang-orang yang takut kepada siksa yang pedih.

arabic: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
transliteration: Wa fee Moosaaa iz arsalnaahu ilaa Fir'wna bisultaa nim mubeen

translations.en.sahih: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.
translations.en.pickthall: And in Moses (too, there is a portent) when We sent him unto Pharaoh with clear warrant,
translations.en.yusufali: And in Moses (was another Sign): Behold, We sent him to Pharaoh, with authority manifest.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan juga pada Musa (terdapat tanda-tanda kekuasaan Allah) ketika Kami mengutusnya kepada Fir'aun dengan membawa mukjizat yang nyata.

arabic: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌۭ
transliteration: Fatawalla biruknihee wa qaala saahirun aw majnoon

translations.en.sahih: But he turned away with his supporters and said," A magician or a madman."
translations.en.pickthall: But he withdrew (confiding) in his might, and said: A wizard or a madman.
translations.en.yusufali: But (Pharaoh) turned back with his Chiefs, and said, "A sorcerer, or one possessed!"
translations.id.indonesian: Maka dia (Fir'aun) berpaling (dari iman) bersama tentaranya dan berkata: "Dia adalah seorang tukang sihir atau seorang gila".

arabic: فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ
transliteration: Fa akhaznaahu wa junoo dahoo fanabaznaahum fil yammi wa huwa muleem

translations.en.sahih: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.
translations.en.pickthall: So We seized him and his hosts and flung them in the sea, for he was reprobate.
translations.en.yusufali: So We took him and his forces, and threw them into the sea; and his was the blame.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka Kami siksa dia dan tentaranya lalu Kami lemparkan mereka ke dalam laut, sedang dia melakukan pekerjaan yang tercela.

arabic: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
transliteration: Wa fee 'Aadin iz arsalnaa 'alaihimur reehal'aqeem

translations.en.sahih: And in 'Aad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.
translations.en.pickthall: And in (the tribe of) A'ad (there is a portent) when we sent the fatal wind against them.
translations.en.yusufali: And in the 'Ad (people) (was another Sign): Behold, We sent against them the devastating Wind:
translations.id.indonesian: Dan juga pada (kisah) Aad ketika Kami kirimkan kepada mereka angin yang membinasakan,

arabic: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
transliteration: Maa tazaru min shai'in atat 'alaihi illaa ja'alat hu karrameem

translations.en.sahih: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.
translations.en.pickthall: It spared naught that it reached, but made it (all) as dust.
translations.en.yusufali: It left nothing whatever that it came up against, but reduced it to ruin and rottenness.
translations.id.indonesian: angin itu tidak membiarkan satupun yang dilaluinya, melainkan dijadikannya seperti serbuk.

arabic: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ
transliteration: Wa fee Samooda iz qeela lahum tamatta''oo hattaa heen

translations.en.sahih: And in Thamud, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."
translations.en.pickthall: And in (the tribe of) Thamud (there is a portent) when it was told them: Take your ease awhile.
translations.en.yusufali: And in the Thamud (was another Sign): Behold, they were told, "Enjoy (your brief day) for a little while!"
translations.id.indonesian: Dan pada (kisah) kaum Tsamud ketika dikatakan kepada mereka: "Bersenang-senanglah kalian sampai suatu waktu".

arabic: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
transliteration: Fa'ataw 'an amri Rabbihim fa akhazal humus saa'iqatu wa hum yanzuroon

translations.en.sahih: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.
translations.en.pickthall: But they rebelled against their Lord's decree, and so the thunderbolt overtook them even while they gazed;
translations.en.yusufali: But they insolently defied the Command of their Lord: So the stunning noise (of an earthquake) seized them, even while they were looking on.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka mereka berlaku angkuh terhadap perintah Tuhannya, lalu mereka disambar petir dan mereka melihatnya.

arabic: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍۢ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ
transliteration: Famas tataa'oo min qiyaaminw wa maa kaanoo muntasireen

translations.en.sahih: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.
translations.en.pickthall: And they were unable to rise up, nor could they help themselves.
translations.en.yusufali: Then they could not even stand (on their feet), nor could they help themselves.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka mereka sekali-kali tidak dapat bangun dan tidak pula mendapat pertolongan,

arabic: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا فَٰسِقِينَ
transliteration: Wa qawma Noohim min qablu innahum kaano qawman faasiqeen

translations.en.sahih: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.
translations.en.pickthall: And the folk of Noah aforetime. Lo! they were licentious folk.
translations.en.yusufali: So were the People of Noah before them for they wickedly transgressed.
translations.id.indonesian: dan (Kami membinasakan) kaum Nuh sebelum itu. Sesungguhnya mereka adalah kaum yang fasik.

arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍۢ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
transliteration: Wassamaaa'a banainaa haa bi aydinw wa innaa lamoosi'oon

translations.en.sahih: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander.
translations.en.pickthall: We have built the heaven with might, and We it is Who make the vast extent (thereof).
translations.en.yusufali: With power and skill did We construct the Firmament: for it is We Who create the vastness of pace.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan langit itu Kami bangun dengan kekuasaan (Kami) dan sesungguhnya Kami benar-benar berkuasa

arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَٰهِدُونَ
transliteration: Wal arda farashnaahaa fani'mal maahidoon

translations.en.sahih: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.
translations.en.pickthall: And the earth have We laid out, how gracious is the Spreader (thereof)!
translations.en.yusufali: And We have spread out the (spacious) earth: How excellently We do spread out!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan bumi itu Kami hamparkan, maka sebaik-baik yang menghamparkan (adalah Kami).

arabic: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
transliteration: Wa min kulli shai'in khalaqnaa zawjaini la'allakum tazakkaroon

translations.en.sahih: And of all things We created two mates; perhaps you will remember.
translations.en.pickthall: And all things We have created by pairs, that haply ye may reflect.
translations.en.yusufali: And of every thing We have created pairs: That ye may receive instruction.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan segala sesuatu Kami ciptakan berpasang-pasangan supaya kamu mengingat kebesaran Allah.

arabic: فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
transliteration: Fafirrooo ilal laahi innee lakum minhu nazeerum mubeen

translations.en.sahih: So flee to Allah. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
translations.en.pickthall: Therefor flee unto Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from him.
translations.en.yusufali: Hasten ye then (at once) to Allah: I am from Him a Warner to you, clear and open!
translations.id.indonesian: Maka segeralah kembali kepada (mentaati) Allah. Sesungguhnya aku seorang pemberi peringatan yang nyata dari Allah untukmu.

arabic: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
transliteration: Wa laa taj'aloo ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhara innee lakum minhu nazeerum mubeen

translations.en.sahih: And do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
translations.en.pickthall: And set not any other god along with Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from Him.
translations.en.yusufali: And make not another an object of worship with Allah: I am from Him a Warner to you, clear and open!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan janganlah kamu mengadakan tuhan yang lain disamping Allah. Sesungguhnya aku seorang pemberi peringatan yang nyata dari Allah untukmu.

arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
transliteration: Kazaalika maaa atal lazeena min qablihim mir Rasoolin illaa qaaloo saahirun aw majnoon

translations.en.sahih: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."
translations.en.pickthall: Even so there came no messenger unto those before them but they said: A wizard or a madman!
translations.en.yusufali: Similarly, no messenger came to the Peoples before them, but they said (of him) in like manner, "A sorcerer, or one possessed"!
translations.id.indonesian: Demikianlah tidak seorang rasulpun yang datang kepada orang-orang yang sebelum mereka, melainkan mereka mengatakan: "Dia adalah seorang tukang sihir atau seorang gila".

arabic: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ
transliteration: Atawaasaw bih; bal hum qawmun taaghoon

translations.en.sahih: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.
translations.en.pickthall: Have they handed down (the saying) as an heirloom one unto another? Nay, but they are froward folk.
translations.en.yusufali: Is this the legacy they have transmitted, one to another? Nay, they are themselves a people transgressing beyond bounds!
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah mereka saling berpesan tentang apa yang dikatakan itu. Sebenarnya mereka adalah kaum yang melampaui batas.

arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍۢ
transliteration: Fatawalla 'anhum famaaa anta bimaloom

translations.en.sahih: So leave them, [O Muhammad], for you are not to be blamed.
translations.en.pickthall: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad), for thou art in no wise blameworthy,
translations.en.yusufali: So turn away from them: not thine is the blame.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka berpalinglah kamu dari mereka dan kamu sekali-kali tidak tercela.

arabic: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
transliteration: Wa zakkir fa innaz zikraa tanfa'ul mu'mineen

translations.en.sahih: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.
translations.en.pickthall: And warn, for warning profiteth believers.
translations.en.yusufali: But teach (thy Message) for teaching benefits the Believers.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tetaplah memberi peringatan, karena sesungguhnya peringatan itu bermanfaat bagi orang-orang yang beriman.

arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
transliteration: Wa maa khalaqtul jinna wal insa illaa liya'budoon

translations.en.sahih: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.
translations.en.pickthall: I created the jinn and humankind only that they might worship Me.
translations.en.yusufali: I have only created Jinns and men, that they may serve Me.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan aku tidak menciptakan jin dan manusia melainkan supaya mereka mengabdi kepada-Ku.

arabic: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍۢ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ
transliteration: Maaa ureedu minhum mir rizqinw wa maaa ureedu anyyut'imoon

translations.en.sahih: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.
translations.en.pickthall: I seek no livelihood from them, nor do I ask that they should feed Me.
translations.en.yusufali: No Sustenance do I require of them, nor do I require that they should feed Me.
translations.id.indonesian: Aku tidak menghendaki rezeki sedikitpun dari mereka dan Aku tidak menghendaki supaya mereka memberi-Ku makan.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
transliteration: Innal laaha Huwar Razzaaqu Zul Quwwatil Mateen

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, it is Allah who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! Allah! He it is that giveth livelihood, the Lord of unbreakable might.
translations.en.yusufali: For Allah is He Who gives (all) Sustenance,- Lord of Power,- Steadfast (for ever).
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Allah Dialah Maha Pemberi rezeki Yang mempunyai Kekuatan lagi Sangat Kokoh.

arabic: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًۭا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
transliteration: Fa inna lillazeena zalamoo zanoobam misla zanoobi ashaabihim falaa yasta'jiloon

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their predecessors, so let them not impatiently urge Me.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! for those who (now) do wrong there is an evil day like unto the evil day (which came for) their likes (of old); so let them not ask Me to hasten on (that day).
translations.en.yusufali: For the Wrong-doers, their portion is like unto the portion of their fellows (of earlier generations): then let them not ask Me to hasten (that portion)!
translations.id.indonesian: Maka sesungguhnya untuk orang-orang zalim ada bagian (siksa) seperti bahagian teman mereka (dahulu); maka janganlah mereka meminta kepada-Ku untuk menyegerakannya.

arabic: فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
transliteration: Fawailul lillazeena kafaroo miny yawmihimul lazee yoo'adoon

translations.en.sahih: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
translations.en.pickthall: And woe unto those who disbelieve, from (that) their day which they are promised.
translations.en.yusufali: Woe, then, to the Unbelievers, on account of that Day of theirs which they have been promised!
translations.id.indonesian: Maka kecelakaanlah bagi orang-orang yang kafir pada hari yang diancamkan kepada mereka.
